about_the_game:
Era One – Demo (9 - 18 June 2025)

Era One is a real-time strategy game with a strong base-building component, focused on battles, resource management, and base development.

In this demo, you'll experience the core gameplay features that define the full game.

  • Full access to ship and base customization using modular components.

  • Real-time strategy mechanics with dynamic space battles.

  • Resource management, research, and technological progression.

Three game modes are available.

  • Enemy Waves: Face relentless waves of enemies in fast-paced combat. Survive the onslaught and strike back at the enemy base.

  • Scenario: Tackle small to mid-sized maps with specific objectives and enemy stations to destroy.

  • Survival: Explore a vast, resource-rich area. Use stealth or force to overcome hidden enemies and uncover secrets.

The goal of the demo is to gather solid feedback and build a user base to help guide the development.

The game is developed by Team Complex, a group of passionate space combat game enthusiasts, known for creating the Complex mod and for their collaborations on Homeworld RM.

The project is currently in development and will be publicly released in Early Access at the end of July 2025.

Our philosophy is to move forward step by step, listening closely to community feedback, and always ensuring that each build is thoroughly tested, polished, and fully enjoyable at every stage of development. We dedicate a lot of time to bug fixing and refining the game before every release. In other words, what’s included works well and is carefully tested.

We hope you enjoy it, and please feel free to share any thoughts or opinions, we’re ready to discuss everything with you in the community!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 o AMD Ryzen 5 (or similar)
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 (or equivalent) with at least 4 GB of dedicated memory
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i9 or AMD Ryzen 9 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT (or higher) with at least 6 GB of dedicated memory
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Sound card compatible with DirectX
